description: Microentrepreneur is responsible for operating and managing retail pharmacy services, including storage, dispensing, and sale of pharmaceutical and biological products in compliance with legal and regulatory guidelines. The job role also involves prescription validation, customer service, inventory control, and the ability to plan, open, and run a Jan Aushadhi Kendra, while promoting safe medicine use and ensuring adherence to Good Storage and Pharmacy Practices.
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Entrepreneurship

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Introduction to life Sciences Sector and basics of Retail Pharmacy
Perform Entrepreneurship and Business Planning Activities in Pharmacy Setup
Adhere to Drug Laws, Licensing, and Regulatory Norms in Pharmacy Practice
Collaborate with Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Community Stakeholders in Retail Pharmacy
Initiate and Operate Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra (PMBJK) as per SOP
Supervise Customer Engagement, Prescription Fulfilment, and Sales Transactions in Retail Pharmacy
Supervise Manage Drug Storage, Inventory Rotation, and Stock Replenishment in Retail Pharmacy
Perform Pharmacovigilance, Promote Responsible Antibiotic Use, and Ensure Safe Handling of Controlled Substances
Comply EHS Rules and Sanitization Protocol at Retail Pharmacy in Compliance with Good Storage Area Practices

subSector: Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Research and Development Services
